# Countries

One page per country, giving the values for an OG-Core calibration and the estimates behind them. Countries without their own estimate of adult mortality use the [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md). Countries not listed have no DHS survey with a wealth breakdown; regional medians are given in [the main results](../../ANALYSIS.md#regional-medians).
